tools.name: system_ping
tools.description: Check that Moho is reachable. Returns the Moho version, plugin version and whether a document is open. Call this first in every session.

tools.name: system_selfTest
tools.description: Run an end-to-end self test inside Moho (creates a temporary vector layer and bone layer, draws shapes, keyframes a bone, renders a frame, then deletes everything). Returns pass/fail per step. Run it once per Moho install before a long production job: it tells you exactly which API paths work on this Moho build. A document must be open.

params.name: cleanup
params.description: Delete the temporary layers afterwards (default true)

tools.name: document_getInfo
tools.description: Get information about the open document: name, path, size, FPS, start/end frame, duration, layer counts.

tools.name: document_getLayers
tools.description: Get the full layer tree (hierarchy) of the open document.

tools.name: document_setFrame
tools.description: Move the timeline playhead to a frame.

tools.name: document_save
tools.description: Save the document. Pass filePath to Save As; omit it to save in place.

tools.name: document_undo
tools.description: Undo the most recent change. Returns success=false when there is nothing to undo.

tools.name: document_redo
tools.description: Redo the most recently undone change.

tools.name: document_setCamera
tools.description: Animate the document camera at a frame: 3D position (posX/posY/posZ), tilt/pan/roll in radians, and zoom (1 = default, >1 zooms in). Only supplied components are written.

tools.name: render_frame
tools.description: Render one frame of the document to an image file (png recommended). Unlike document_screenshot it writes to the path you choose, e.g. for thumbnails or storyboards.

tools.name: project_new
tools.description: Create a new empty document and optionally configure it. WARNING: replaces the active document — save first. Typical film settings: 1920x1080 at 24 fps.

tools.name: project_open
tools.description: Open an existing .moho project. WARNING: replaces the active document.

tools.name: project_setProperties
tools.description: Change settings of the open document: size, FPS, start/end frame, background color. Only supplied fields change.

tools.name: project_import
tools.description: Import a file as a new layer: image (PNG/JPG/PSD), vector (SVG, EPS/AI), audio (WAV/MP3) or video. Set asImageSequence=true to import a numbered image sequence. Returns the new layer's id when Moho exposes it.

params.name: filePath
params.description: Absolute path of the file to import

params.name: asImageSequence
params.description: Treat the path as the first image of a sequence (or a folder)

tools.name: layer_getProperties
tools.description: Get a layer's properties: type, visibility, lock state, opacity and transform.

tools.name: layer_getChildren
tools.description: Get the direct children of a group layer.

params.name: layerId
params.description: Absolute ID of the group layer

tools.name: layer_getBones
tools.description: List every bone in a bone layer (id, name, position, angle, length, parentId).

params.name: layerId
params.description: Absolute ID of the bone layer

tools.name: layer_createLayer
tools.description: Create a layer. If parentId (a group) is given, the new layer is created inside it. Returns the new layerId — keep it, every other tool addresses layers by this id.

params.name: parentId
params.description: Absolute ID of a group to create the layer in (default: document root)

tools.name: layer_deleteLayer
tools.description: Delete a layer by absolute ID (undoable inside Moho).

tools.name: layer_duplicate
tools.description: Duplicate a layer (and its children); the copy is placed above the original. Use it to clone a character for a second scene or to repeat props.

tools.name: layer_setName
tools.description: Rename a layer.

tools.name: layer_selectLayer
tools.description: Select a layer in the Moho UI.

tools.name: layer_setVisibility
tools.description: Show or hide a layer.

tools.name: layer_setOpacity
tools.description: Set layer opacity at a frame (0 transparent .. 1 opaque). Animates when set at several frames.

tools.name: layer_setTransform
tools.description: Set a layer's translation / rotation (radians) / scale at a frame. Only supplied values change. Translation and scale are 3D; Z defaults to the existing value.

tools.name: layer_setParentBone
tools.description: Make a layer follow a bone (e.g. parent a hand layer to a wrist bone). boneId = -1 clears. This is how art layers get attached to a rig.

params.name: boneId
params.description: Bone index in the parent skeleton, or -1 to clear

tools.name: layer_placeInGroup
tools.description: Move a layer into a group. top=true places it at the top of the stack.

params.name: parentGroupId
params.description: Absolute ID of the destination group

tools.name: layer_placeBehind
tools.description: Reorder: move a layer behind (below) another layer in the same group.

tools.name: layer_activateAction
tools.description: Switch into editing a named action (e.g. a smart-bone dial). Keyframes set while it is active are stored in that action. Pass "" or omit to return to the main timeline. ALWAYS return to the main timeline afterwards.

tools.name: layer_listActions
tools.description: List a layer's actions, which one is being edited, and which are smart-bone actions.

tools.name: layer_setBlur
tools.description: Animate a layer's blur amount (depth of field, focus pulls).

tools.name: layer_setShadow
tools.description: Animate a layer's drop shadow. All fields optional; enabled toggles it.

tools.name: layer_setOutline
tools.description: Animate a layer's outline. All fields optional; enabled toggles it.

tools.name: switch_setActive
tools.description: Choose which child of a switch layer is visible from a frame onward. Use switch layers for mouth shapes (lip-sync), eye states (open/closed/blink) and swap-art expressions. Pass childName or childIndex.

params.name: layerId
params.description: Absolute ID of the switch layer

tools.name: switch_getActive
tools.description: Read which child of a switch layer is visible at a frame.

tools.name: image_setSource
tools.description: Set the file on an image layer (PNG/JPG/PSD, image sequence folder, or movie).

tools.name: image_getSource
tools.description: Read an image layer's source path, pixel size and movie/PSD/sequence flags.

tools.name: particle_setEmitter
tools.description: Configure a particle layer (rain, snow, sparks, smoke). All settings optional; FinalizeSettings runs automatically.

tools.name: bone_getProperties
tools.description: Get a bone's position, angle, scale, length and parent.

tools.name: bone_addBone
tools.description: Add a bone to a bone layer. Rest-pose fields are optional. Returns boneId (= index, assigned in creation order). For whole skeletons prefer rig_buildSkeleton / rig_buildHumanoid.

params.name: layerId
params.description: Absolute ID of the bone layer

tools.name: bone_deleteBone
tools.description: Delete a bone. recursive=true also deletes descendants; otherwise children are re-parented.

tools.name: bone_setRestPose
tools.description: Edit a bone's setup (rest) pose: position, angle, length, scale, parent, name. Unlike bone_setTransform this is not animated.

tools.name: bone_setTransform
tools.description: Pose a bone at a frame (creates keyframes): angle (radians), posX/posY, scale. Only supplied values change. Use animation_setInterpolation for easing.

tools.name: bone_selectBone
tools.description: Select a bone in the Moho UI.

tools.name: bone_createSmartAction
tools.description: Create a smart-bone action named after the bone. Then call layer_activateAction with that name, pose bones with bone_setTransform at the dial's frames, and return to the main timeline. See rig_createSmartBone for the whole sequence in one call.

tools.name: mesh_getPoints
tools.description: List the points (vertices) of a vector layer.

params.name: layerId
params.description: Absolute ID of the vector layer

tools.name: mesh_getShapes
tools.description: List the shapes (fills/strokes) of a vector layer with their colors.

tools.name: mesh_getCurves
tools.description: List a vector layer's curves with the mapping from curve-local to mesh-global point indices. Needed before mesh_setBezierHandle.

tools.name: mesh_addPoint
tools.description: Low-level: add a point at (x, y). With connectToPointId it attaches to that point; with startNewCurve (or an empty mesh) it starts a curve; otherwise it appends. For real artwork prefer draw_ellipse / draw_rect / draw_polygon / draw_polyline.

tools.name: mesh_createShape
tools.description: Low-level: create a fill/stroke shape from point indices (a closed loop for a filled shape). Colors are hex strings.

tools.name: mesh_setPointCurvature
tools.description: Smooth (≈1) or sharpen (0) a vertex. Makes shapes look hand-drawn instead of polygonal.

tools.name: mesh_setBezierHandle
tools.description: Set one bezier control handle on a curve point (curve-local index — see mesh_getCurves). prePoint=true targets the incoming handle.

tools.name: mesh_bindPoints
tools.description: Bind mesh points to a bone so the bone deforms them. boneId: -1 unbind, -2 flexi-bind to all bones, otherwise a bone index. See rig_bindLayerToBone to bind a whole layer.

tools.name: mesh_setShapeStyle
tools.description: Restyle an existing shape: fill/stroke color (animatable via frame), stroke width, name, and hasFill/hasOutline toggles.

tools.name: animation_getKeyframes
tools.description: List keyframes of a channel on a layer.

tools.name: animation_getFrameState
tools.description: Get a layer's full animated state at a frame.

tools.name: animation_setKeyframe
tools.description: Set a keyframe on a channel: a number for scalar channels (rotation, opacity), {x, y} for vec2 channels (translation, scale).

tools.name: animation_deleteKeyframe
tools.description: Delete a keyframe.

tools.name: animation_setInterpolation
tools.description: Set easing on an existing keyframe: "linear", "smooth", "ease_in", "ease_out" or "step". Use "step" for blinks/pops and "smooth" for natural motion.

tools.name: draw_ellipse
tools.description: Draw a filled ellipse/circle (heads, eyes, balls, suns). Coordinates are layer units: the default 16:9 camera shows roughly x -1.78..1.78, y -1..1 (verify with document_screenshot). ry defaults to rx (circle). segments (4-64, default 8) controls smoothness.

params.name: layerId
params.description: Absolute ID of the VECTOR layer to draw into

tools.name: draw_rect
tools.description: Draw a rectangle from its bottom-left corner (x, y) with width/height (floors, walls, signs, sky). Coordinates are layer units: the default 16:9 camera shows roughly x -1.78..1.78, y -1..1 (verify with document_screenshot).

params.name: layerId
params.description: Absolute ID of the VECTOR layer to draw into

tools.name: draw_polygon
tools.description: Draw a closed polygon/blob through 3+ points (bodies, hair, hills, clothes). smooth > 0 (try 0.5-1) rounds the corners into organic curves. Coordinates are layer units: the default 16:9 camera shows roughly x -1.78..1.78, y -1..1 (verify with document_screenshot).

params.name: layerId
params.description: Absolute ID of the VECTOR layer to draw into

tools.name: draw_polyline
tools.description: Draw an open stroke through 2+ points (mouths, eyebrows, whiskers, ground lines). strokeColor is required. Coordinates are layer units: the default 16:9 camera shows roughly x -1.78..1.78, y -1..1 (verify with document_screenshot).

params.name: layerId
params.description: Absolute ID of the VECTOR layer to draw into

tools.name: document_screenshot
tools.description: See your work. mode "scene" (default) renders the clean frame; "full" captures the whole Moho window (timeline, layers panel, bones). Take a screenshot after every significant change and compare it with what the user asked for.

params.name: width
params.description: Render width in scene mode (rarely needed)

params.name: height
params.description: Render height in scene mode (rarely needed)

params.name: maxWidth
params.description: Shrink the returned image to this width to save tokens (default 800 scene / 1280 full; 0 = original size). Use a larger value only to inspect fine detail.

tools.name: input_mouseClick
tools.description: Click at window-relative (x, y). Use after document_screenshot(mode='full') to operate parts of Moho that have no API.

tools.name: input_mouseDrag
tools.description: Drag from (startX, startY) to (endX, endY), window-relative.

tools.name: input_sendKeys
tools.description: Send a shortcut to Moho, e.g. "ctrl+z", "ctrl+shift+z", "space", "ctrl+s", "f5".

tools.name: batch_execute
tools.description: Run many Moho operations in ONE round-trip (~300 ms total instead of ~300 ms each). Use it whenever you have 2+ operations. Method names use DOT notation ("bone.setTransform", "draw.ellipse", "layer.createLayer"); params match the tool schemas. Not allowed inside a batch: document.screenshot, render.frames, project.new/open, system.selfTest, batch.execute. Returns per-operation results and a summary; use stopOnError when later operations depend on earlier ones.

tools.name: rig_buildSkeleton
tools.description: Build a whole skeleton in one call from a list of named bones (parents must come before children). Creates the bone layer unless layerId is given. Returns bone name -> bone index, which the other rig_/anim_ tools and bone_setTransform use.

params.name: layerId
params.description: Existing bone layer; omitted = create a new one

params.name: parentId
params.description: Group to create the bone layer in

tools.name: rig_buildHumanoid
tools.description: Create a ready-made front-facing humanoid skeleton (hip, spine, neck, head, shoulders, arms, hands, legs, feet) named so anim_walkCycle / anim_wave work immediately. Character's left (_L) is on the screen's right. ALWAYS verify with document_screenshot(mode='full'); if bones are visibly mis-attached, restart Moho's bridge with MOHO_MCP_BONE_ORIGIN=tip.

tools.name: rig_attachLayers
tools.description: Attach artwork layers to bones. mode "parent" makes the whole layer follow one bone (rigid parts: head, hands, props). "bind" binds every point of a vector layer to one bone. "flexi" flexi-binds the layer to ALL bones (bendy limbs, torso). boneName refers to a bone in the given bone layer.

tools.name: rig_createSmartBone
tools.description: Create a smart bone (Moho Pro) in one call. A smart bone ties the CONTROL bone's rotation to an action: while the action plays from frame 0 (neutral) to its last frame, the control bone rotates 0 -> controlAngle and the other bones/layers move as recorded. The tool creates the action named after the control bone, records every pose inside it, keys the control bone itself to controlAngle at the last frame, then returns to the main timeline. Use a long enough action (24+ frames) so in-betweens are smooth. Make the last-frame pose the extreme one (e.g. head turned fully).

params.name: controlBoneId
params.description: The bone that becomes the dial

params.name: controlAngle
params.description: Radians the control bone reaches at the last frame (default PI/2 = 90 degrees)

tools.name: anim_walkCycle
tools.description: Animate a walk cycle on a humanoid rig (bones are found by name — rig_buildHumanoid names them correctly). Keys are placed so the cycle loops seamlessly; Moho smooths between them. Character faces +x (right).

params.name: cycles
params.description: Number of full cycles (2 steps each)

params.name: travel
params.description: Hip X travel per cycle (0 = in place)

params.name: intensity
params.description: Multiplier on swing, bounce and lean (default 1)

tools.name: anim_runCycle
tools.description: Animate a run cycle on a humanoid rig (bones are found by name — rig_buildHumanoid names them correctly). Keys are placed so the cycle loops seamlessly; Moho smooths between them. Character faces +x (right).

params.name: cycles
params.description: Number of full cycles (2 steps each)

params.name: travel
params.description: Hip X travel per cycle (0 = in place)

params.name: intensity
params.description: Multiplier on swing, bounce and lean (default 1)

tools.name: anim_wave
tools.description: Raise an arm, wave the forearm, lower it (greeting). Side L = character's left (screen right).

tools.name: anim_oscillate
tools.description: Sine-wave one bone property around its rest value: breathing (spine scale), nodding (head angle), tail wag, floating (posY), swinging pendulum. The loop returns to its start value.

tools.name: anim_blink
tools.description: Add natural, irregular blinking over a frame range. Either drive a SWITCH layer (switchLayerId + openChild + closedChild names) or squash eye layers vertically (eyeLayerIds). Pass `at` for exact frames; otherwise blinks are generated deterministically from `seed`.

tools.name: anim_lipSync
tools.description: Set mouth shapes over time on a switch layer. cues = [{frame, mouth}] where mouth is the child layer name (e.g. rest, AI, E, O, U, MBP, FV, L, etc.). Derive cue frames from the dialogue timing: frame = seconds * fps.

tools.name: anim_lipSyncFromAudio
tools.description: Automatic lip-sync like Moho's 'audio sync source': analyses the loudness of an audio file and sets a switch layer's mouth shape per frame (quiet = first/closed child, loud = last/wide-open child). Pass the mouth children ordered CLOSED -> OPEN. Works best with clean speech (no music/noise). For phoneme-accurate sync use Papagayo data through the Moho GUI.

params.name: audioPath
params.description: Absolute path of the voice file (wav/mp3/…)

params.name: mouths
params.description: Child layer names ordered from closed to wide open

tools.name: anim_layerPath
tools.description: Move/rotate/scale a layer through keyframes in one call: keys = [{frame, x?, y?, rotation?, scale?}]. For props, whole characters sliding across the scene, bouncing balls, floating clouds.

tools.name: anim_fade
tools.description: Fade layers in or out (opacity from -> to over a frame range). Use 0 -> 1 to fade in, 1 -> 0 to fade out.

tools.name: anim_cameraMove
tools.description: Camera move between two poses: pan (x/y), push-in / pull-out (zoom), roll. Examples: push-in = zoom 1 -> 1.4; pan right = x 0 -> 1.

tools.name: anim_cameraShake
tools.description: Camera shake for impacts, explosions or handheld feel; returns to the base position at endFrame.

params.name: amplitude
params.description: Peak offset in layer units (0.02 subtle, 0.1 violent)

tools.name: render_exportVideo
tools.description: Render the open document to a video file (.mp4, .mov, .webm or .gif). Renders every frame through Moho into a temporary PNG sequence, then encodes with ffmpeg (optionally muxing an audio track). Long scenes take minutes and Moho's UI is busy meanwhile. Frames default to the document's start..end range.

params.name: outputPath
params.description: Absolute path of the video to write

params.name: audioOffset
params.description: Seconds: >0 skips into the audio, <0 delays it

params.name: keepFrames
params.description: Keep the PNG sequence (frames engine only, default false)

params.name: engine
params.description: "moho" = Moho's own command-line renderer (headless, includes the project's audio layers; needs the document saved), "frames" = render PNGs through the plugin then ffmpeg, "auto" = try moho, fall back to frames

tools.name: render_concatVideos
tools.description: Join scene videos into one film, in the order given. Fast stream copy by default (all inputs must share codec, size and fps — true for videos from render_exportVideo with the same settings); set reencode=true to normalise mismatched inputs.

tools.name: render_addAudio
tools.description: Add or replace the soundtrack of an existing video (video stream is copied, audio encoded as AAC).

tools.name: render_checkEnvironment
tools.description: Verify ffmpeg is installed and reachable before a long export.
